evidenceScope: Technical API execution and validated media persistence only; not business evaluation or product-parameter acceptance.
reason: Text and single-image API smoke tests produced decodable files, but both outputs contained audio and used 1280x704 instead of the requested 1280x720. Product conformance, billing evidence, server persistence, authorization and evaluation remain blocking gates.

capabilityCandidate.meaning: Documented request presets; not an assertion that every output meets the requested constraints.

importantProviderSemantics.duration: 121 frames at 24 fps yielded 5.041667s in ffprobe, while the API reported seconds=5. Actual file metadata is authoritative for media validation.
importantProviderSemantics.size: Requested 1280x720 was mapped to 1280x704 in both samples. Do not silently crop/stretch or advertise exact 16:9 compliance.
importantProviderSemantics.imageInput: One pinned, SHA-256-verified repository-owned image was used. No customer or portrait material was uploaded.
importantProviderSemantics.audio: audio=true is not exposed by this adapter. audio=false is not sent to Agnes because no documented control exists; actual files still had AAC tracks. A no-audio guarantee requires explicit post-processing and re-validation.
importantProviderSemantics.resultUrl: Support documented metadata.url and observed top-level url only. Keep the original opaque query ID.
importantProviderSemantics.retry: Never retry POST automatically. Persist the original ID and recover with GET if finalization fails.

pricingEvidence.note: Page pricing is not proof of an account-level zero bill; do not infer actual charges from it.
